scope: Starting commit d795e4e has only a README, so none is implemented here. Similar physics exists in peers: novelty is a hypothesis, not a claim of worldwide originality. Registry gates decide empirical lane distinctness.
lane: SSP1 — residualized signed normal-direction scarp-profile likelihood; no incumbent blend, no catalogue distance feature, no coordinate feature
lane_assignment: Autonomously declared because the prompt refers to a method paragraph but supplies none. No external parallel-run coordinator assignment is claimed.

ranked_candidates.hypothesis: An antisymmetric step left after removing a smooth terrain profile identifies narrow fault scarps that a generic ridge detector confuses with symmetric ridges and valleys.
layers: Owner-quantized GeoDAWN K and Th channels
ranked_candidates.signature: Sample nine heights along the local gradient normal; project both the observed profile and tanh step templates off [1,t,t^2]; use normalized reduction in squared residual and signed step amplitude at widths 0.7 and 1.4 px. Add tangent persistence and independent gravity-gradient alignment. K and Th are contrast controls, NOT a ratio of physical concentrations.
ranked_candidates.why_uncatalogued: The transform uses no fault positions. Buried or subtle scarps may be nominated wherever the observed cross-section has the target shape, including away from catalogue traces. Whether it transfers to expert new faults is unknown.
ranked_candidates.contrast: Peer H19/H25/H33 emphasize ridge evidence, thinning, catalogue collars or analogue tip geometry; this lane explicitly fits a step against a smooth null before learning. It is not a union or perturbation of their rasters.
ranked_candidates.mimic: Alluvial-fan terrace or paleoshoreline break; road embankment; lithologic contact
ranked_candidates.expected_DTI_improvement: Highest qualitative priority, not a numerical score projection; falsifiable on withheld segments
ranked_candidates.implementation_cost: Medium: label-free profile transforms and eight buffered fits on existing CPU-accessible layers
ranked_candidates.status: selected single lane, parameters frozen before results

ranked_candidates.hypothesis: A spatial offset between magnetic and gravity edge centrelines identifies covered structural boundaries rather than exposed lithologic contacts.
ranked_candidates.signature: Normal-direction cross-correlation of bandpassed gravity and RTP gradients; encode the peak lag and confidence, not just edge magnitude
ranked_candidates.why_uncatalogued: May detect covered structures with little topographic expression; does not extend known traces
ranked_candidates.contrast: Existing tilt, worm-persistence and Euler families detect coincident edges; this proposal tests a displaced cross-profile signature. Cross-site novelty remains unproven.
ranked_candidates.mimic: Dipping intrusive contact, remanent magnetization, survey-height artefact
ranked_candidates.expected_DTI_improvement: Second qualitative priority; hidden-fault transfer uncertain, no numerical projection
ranked_candidates.implementation_cost: Medium-high; derivative stability and survey seams must be controlled

ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Narrow low-relief conductive breaches, rather than broad conductive basins, distinguish permeable structural necks in sediment cover.
ranked_candidates.signature: Scale-normalized conductivity Hessian saddle plus a one-dimensional neck-width test at an independently detected gravity step
ranked_candidates.why_uncatalogued: Catalogue-independent, designed for covered basin interiors rather than already mapped mountain fronts
ranked_candidates.contrast: Unlike prior simple clay-cap, strain-saddle and geothermal favorability multiplication, test a neck versus smooth-basin null. Similarity to peer saddles is a risk, not certified novelty.
ranked_candidates.mimic: Saline groundwater channel or sedimentary facies boundary
ranked_candidates.expected_DTI_improvement: Third qualitative priority; conductivity resolution may be too coarse
ranked_candidates.implementation_cost: Low-medium using existing stack; no new bytes required

ranked_candidates.hypothesis: A radiometrically quiet scarp whose step persists across terrain-smoothing scales is more structural than an erosional lithology boundary.
layers: Owner LiDAR step and coherence aggregates
ranked_candidates.signature: Topographic step persistence conditional on low cross-normal rank-contrast in all radiometric channels; use ranks only, not invented concentration ratios
ranked_candidates.why_uncatalogued: Does not consult the catalogue; preferentially tests subtle breaks within a uniform surface unit
ranked_candidates.contrast: Tests radiometric absence as a nuisance-model control rather than positive radiometric alteration fusion. Existing radiometric-scarp methods mean novelty must still be measured.
ranked_candidates.mimic: Uniform-lithology fluvial terrace, agricultural grading or road cut
ranked_candidates.expected_DTI_improvement: Fourth qualitative priority; radiometric quietness is not evidence of a fault by itself

frozen_experiment.model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier; max_iter=70, max_leaf_nodes=15, learning_rate=0.08, l2_regularization=10, min_samples_leaf=60; early_stopping=false
frozen_experiment.training: Only visible faults outside held quadrant plus 15 px collar; negatives >3 px from visible faults; no full-catalogue derived features
frozen_experiment.emission: Priority greedy exclusion at 2.8 px; fixed 37654 full-footprint dot budget, fold area-scaled budget; exact visible-pixel mask only
frozen_experiment.canary: Every supplied model feature alone, AUC on hidden positives versus sampled unlabeled holdout pixels; either-direction AUC >0.90 blocks
frozen_experiment.primary: Pinned shared GEMSDOE32-HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0 pooled DTI, alpha 0.2 beta 0.8, triangular radius 300 m; paired spatial-block 95% CI
frozen_experiment.promotion: Format AND complete registry AND surface AND final-dot uniqueness AND leakage canaries AND paired holdout win against reproducible current best AND selector approval; otherwise negative
frozen_experiment.slot_policy: No upload and no selection. Weekly cap and usage cannot be read without DrivenData authentication.
